def ApproximationRates.fixed {c : D → ℝ} {L : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ m, JetRate l q c m (-L m)) :
    ApproximationRates l q gain c (fun _ => c) where
  growthLoss := L
  tailLoss := 0
  threshold := 0
  stage_growth _ m := hc m
  tail_rate m J _ := by
    simpa only [sub_self] using (rate_zero (l := l) (q := q) (m := m)
      (r := gain J - (0 : ℕ → ℝ) m))
